facts.fact: The Communication Technologies mission's 2025 annual performance plan defines its indicator 1.1.2 as the share of public bodies' sites connected to the integrated administrative network (RNIA), naming RNIA3 as the network for local collectivities and municipalities beside RNIA2 for ministries and RNIA4 for the justice ministry.
facts.system: Réseau National Intégré de l'Administration, RNIA3 (local collectivities and municipalities)

facts.fact: The plan estimates that 71 per cent of the public bodies' sites programmed for connection under the RNIA project were connected in 2024, with 98 per cent expected in 2025 and the remaining sites, given as 1,826, to be completed by 2027; the figure covers ministries, local collectivities, municipalities and sectoral networks together and no share or count of municipalities is given.
facts.system: Réseau National Intégré de l'Administration, RNIA3 (local collectivities and municipalities)

facts.fact: The connection of public bodies' sites to the integrated administrative network, including RNIA3 for local collectivities and municipalities, is a performance indicator of the Ministry of Communication Technologies' digital development programme for 2025.
facts.system: Réseau National Intégré de l'Administration, RNIA3 (local collectivities and municipalities)

facts.fact: The 2025 annual performance plan sets targets for the share of public bodies' sites connected to the integrated administrative network, municipalities' RNIA3 included, of 98 per cent in 2025 and 100 per cent in 2026 and 2027, against 71 per cent in 2024.
facts.system: Réseau National Intégré de l'Administration, RNIA3 (local collectivities and municipalities)

facts.fact: The plan lists the integrated administrative network projects for the ministries and the municipalities among those financed through the communications development fund (صندوق تنمية المواصلات), within a 2025 mission budget of 184 million dinars in payment credits.
facts.system: Réseau National Intégré de l'Administration, RNIA3 (local collectivities and municipalities)
